intro: Hemet Nesingwary raises the stakes of his hunting expedition by sending you after a elusive breed known as Jungle Stalkers. Tracking down ten of these cunning raptors will prove your mettle as a true stalker of wild beasts in Stranglethorn Vale.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Let's see how you handle this next challenge. There is a cagey breed of raptor out there. We call them Jungle Stalkers. They are far more difficult to track down and kill than the other breeds you've been trying your luck at. Kill 10 Jungle Stalkers and I'll tip you off to the best hunting yet.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Bah! What are you doing standing around, friend! A true big game hunter never gives up once his prey is in his sights. Those Jungle Stalkers aren't going to come running up to this campfire and throw themselves in it. Silly friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ho ho!! We have ourselves a true raptor slayer! Nicely done, friend!
